builder.language: python3 standard library only; no network, no subprocess
builder.reason: No assembler in this worktree emits a 041 multi-header container, and the case needs two logical members that share one physical string/type/proto/method table so their numeric indices are equal. The header chain, per-member class_defs/class_data/code and the map lists are written and then re-decoded.

container.chainCheck: 0x00 + 0x78 = 0x78; 0x78 + 0x2d0 = 0x348 = 0x348 physical length, so the chain ends exactly at the physical end of the container

sharedSections.note: Both logical members reference these same physical bytes, so the numeric indices are equal. The shared tables start after both headers, so a member may reference a later member's data while no member references data before its own header.

equalNumericIndices.class_def_idx: 0 in both members (each member has one class_def)

container.memberNote: Both class_defs use type_idx 1 (Lfixtures/Case;) and both class_data entries use method_id_idx 0 (<init>()V) then 1 (f()I), so the numeric indices are identical while the physical items differ. method_ids has 3 entries because Object.<init> is declared alongside the owner's two.

driver.role: The recovered-output Driver calls fixtures.Case.f directly; reference mirror classes are never placed on its classpath.

mirrors.limit: The mirrors are independent Java statements of the two return values. They are not the 041 container and no JVM executed the original bytes.

certificationObligations: The independent projection confirms the original header_offset and the shared section of both logical inputs together with their equal numeric class/method indices.
Each of the two seams satisfies the same expectation for every invocation, without splitting the case id or counting it twice.
The header chain is verified: both headers declare container_size equal to the physical length, header_offset equal to their actual position, and the steps end exactly at container_size.
No header is overlaid, no data range is truncated by a member's file_size, and no section of a member lies before its own header.
Each member's map list follows physical offset order and no item of one member's map addresses bytes of another member's private item.
gaps: The independent dexlib2/041 projection is not executable in this worktree; B03 owns that step and the resulting hashes.
The 041 read path is production Rust that does not exist yet; no Engine observation was manufactured.
The two return values are corroborated by independent Java mirrors run on a local JVM, not by executing the 041 container.
pathBase: case-root: every repository source path is relative to tests/e2e/sources/<case>/, and every generated artifact path is relative to the repository root under .cache/e2e/.
